user.title: Set up KEMS
user.description: KEMS will scan Home Assistant for compatible Octopus electricity and gas, Ohme, and FoxESS Modbus entities. The Control Lab calculates safe desired behaviour but real hardware writes remain blocked.

confirm.title: Choose how KEMS gets your tariff

data_description.tariff_mode: Choose automatic live pricing or a fully manual tariff schedule.
data_description.review_entities: Open the full mapping screen before KEMS is created.

entities.title: Review KEMS source entities
entities.description: Choose the entities KEMS observes. A current import-rate entity is required only in automatic tariff mode. Gas, Ohme, and FoxESS sources can be added later through Reconfigure.

data_description.current_export_rate: Optional observed export-rate entity. The proposal simulation uses the fixed export rate from KEMS settings.
data_description.electricity_standing_charge: Octopus electricity standing charge, used in whole-home cost totals.
data_description.off_peak: Octopus binary sensor that is on during the normal Intelligent Go cheap period.
data_description.intelligent_slot: Octopus binary sensor for an active Intelligent dispatch slot.
data_description.next_offpeak_start: Octopus timestamp for the next cheap-period start.
data_description.offpeak_end: Octopus timestamp for the current or next cheap-period end.
data_description.gas_current_rate: Octopus gas unit rate in p/kWh or GBP/kWh.
data_description.gas_standing_charge: Octopus gas standing charge in p/day or GBP/day.
data_description.gas_meter_total: Cumulative gas meter in kWh or m³. KEMS converts m³ using the options conversion factor.
data_description.gas_usage_today: Octopus current accumulated gas consumption for today.
data_description.gas_cost_today: Octopus current accumulated gas cost for today.
data_description.ev_status: Ohme charger status sensor; KEMS derives connected and charging states from it.
data_description.ev_connected: Optional legacy/custom Ohme connected binary sensor.
data_description.ev_charging: Optional legacy/custom Ohme charging binary sensor.
data_description.ev_soc: Ohme vehicle state of charge percentage.
data_description.house_load_kw: FoxESS total house-load power when installed. Before installation KEMS can use the Octopus current-demand sensor.
data_description.battery_soc: FoxESS Modbus battery state of charge percentage.
data_description.battery_voltage: FoxESS Battery Voltage, used with Battery Current to derive power.
data_description.battery_current: FoxESS Battery Current, used with Battery Voltage to derive power.
data_description.grid_import_kw: FoxESS grid-import power when installed. Before installation KEMS can use the Octopus current-demand sensor.
data_description.grid_export_kw: FoxESS Modbus power currently exported to the grid.
data_description.saving_session_events: BottlecapDave Octopus Energy Power Down event entity containing available_events and joined_events. The legacy Saving Session event is also supported. KEMS plans only around joined sessions.
data_description.saving_session_import_baseline: Optional Octoplus Power Down import baseline sensor used to estimate rewardable net reduction. The legacy Saving Session baseline is also supported.
data_description.saving_session_export_baseline: Optional export-meter baseline variant. KEMS subtracts it from the import baseline to estimate the net baseline.

reconfigure.title: Rescan KEMS source entities

data_description.review_entities: Leave this off to accept the automatic mappings and reload KEMS.

reconfigure_entities.title: Review KEMS source entities
reconfigure_entities.description: Only change a detected entity when KEMS selected the wrong source.

manual_tariff.title: Enter your electricity tariff
manual_tariff.description: Enter prices in pence. KEMS supports a cheap period that crosses midnight and can still recognise Intelligent extra slots when the relevant entities are available.

data_description.tariff_mode: Manual is selected for this setup.
data_description.manual_offpeak_rate_pence: Price paid during the normal cheap period and confirmed Intelligent extra slots.
data_description.export_rate_pence: Fixed payment received per exported kWh.
data_description.manual_offpeak_end: Local Home Assistant time. Overnight periods are supported.
data_description.intelligent_slots_enabled: Requires the Intelligent slot and EV charging sources to confirm an extra slot safely.
data_description.export_tariff_status: Choose Not active while you are waiting for an export tariff. KEMS will value export at 0p and avoid deliberate grid export.

error.invalid_source_mapping: One or more selected entities do not belong to the supported Octopus Energy, Octopus Intelligent, Ohme, or FoxESS Modbus integration. KEMS output entities cannot be selected as inputs.

init.title: KEMS settings
init.description: Choose the part of KEMS you want to configure. Each page saves independently and reloads the integration safely.

tariff.title: Tariff and prices
tariff.description: Use automatic pricing from Home Assistant or enter a tariff manually. Automatic mode keeps the manual values as a safe fallback.

data_description.tariff_mode: Automatic follows configured Home Assistant tariff entities. When a live value is unavailable, KEMS uses the manual fallback values below. Manual always uses the values below.
data_description.manual_day_rate_pence: Price paid outside the normal cheap period.
data_description.manual_offpeak_rate_pence: Price paid during the normal cheap period and confirmed Intelligent extra slots.
data_description.manual_standing_charge_pence: Daily electricity standing charge in pence.
data_description.export_rate_pence: Payment received per exported kWh once Export tariff status is Active. While awaiting an export tariff KEMS uses 0p/kWh regardless of this future rate.
data_description.manual_offpeak_start: Start of the normal cheap period in local Home Assistant time.
data_description.manual_offpeak_end: End of the normal cheap period. Overnight periods are supported.
data_description.intelligent_slots_enabled: Allow a live Intelligent slot plus active EV charging to confirm an extra cheap period.
data_description.export_tariff_status: Not active switches KEMS to no-export self-use planning: battery export is disabled, export value becomes 0p, solar serves the home then battery, and overnight charging leaves forecast solar headroom.

battery.title: Battery, inverter and grid limits
battery.description: Describe the installed or proposed battery system. Site import is separate from inverter output; leave it at 0 until the installer confirms it.

data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Defaults to the quoted 56.42kWh FoxESS battery storage.
data_description.battery_reserve_percent: Defaults to 10%, matching the proposal's 50.77kWh usable capacity.
data_description.battery_initial_percent: Used when no real FoxESS battery SOC is available.
data_description.max_charge_kw: Maximum battery charging power. Defaults to the revised Fox ESS KH7 7kW inverter limit.
data_description.max_discharge_kw: Maximum battery discharge power. Defaults to the revised Fox ESS KH7 7kW inverter limit.
data_description.inverter_ac_limit_kw: Combined simulated solar and battery AC output cannot exceed the revised Fox ESS KH7 7kW limit.
data_description.export_limit_kw: Separate DNO/grid export limit. Runtime export is also capped by the 7kW inverter limit.
data_description.site_import_limit_kw: Installer-confirmed whole-site import limit based on the main fuse and gateway configuration. This is separate from the KH7 7kW output limit; use 0 until confirmed.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Simulation assumption; the proposal does not guarantee conversion efficiency.
data_description.discharge_efficiency: Simulation assumption; the proposal does not guarantee conversion efficiency.
data_description.battery_power_positive_is_discharge: Controls how KEMS separates FoxESS battery charge and discharge totals. Leave enabled when positive power means battery discharge.

solar.title: Solar, export and Power Down
solar.description: Configure the solar estimate, normal export strategy and Octoplus Power Down simulation. Export settings are automatically overridden while the export tariff is not active.

data.proposal_solar_enabled: Use proposal solar model when live PV is unavailable
data.saving_session_enabled: Use joined Octoplus Power Down sessions

data_description.proposal_solar_enabled: Models 21 x 460W panels, 9.66kWp, three roof orientations, and the proposal monthly generation baseline.
data_description.proposal_solar_factor: Scale the proposal baseline for cloud/weather sensitivity; 1.0 uses the proposal average.
data_description.battery_export_enabled: Used only while the export tariff is Active. In Awaiting Export Tariff mode KEMS always disables deliberate battery export.
data_description.simulation_strategy: Used while the export tariff is Active. Awaiting Export Tariff mode automatically uses self-consumption-first planning.
data_description.saving_session_enabled: Hold battery energy before a joined session, cover the home, and maximise permitted export during the higher-reward window. KEMS remains read-only and does not join sessions itself.

financial.title: System cost and ROI
financial.description: Enter the real project costs and financial assumptions used by KEMS payback and ROI reporting.

data_description.system_cost_gbp: Defaults to the quoted system price of £20,995.
data_description.additional_costs_gbp: Add DNO fees, structural work, smart-meter work, or later installation additions.
data_description.grants_rebates_gbp: Deduct grants, rebates, or discounts from the investment KEMS must recover.
data_description.commissioning_date: Leave blank before installation. Set this once the system is commissioned to begin actual ROI and payback tracking.
data_description.annual_maintenance_gbp: KEMS accrues this allowance daily after commissioning.
data_description.manual_system_costs_gbp: All-time repair, servicing, or replacement expenditure already incurred. Update the total when new costs occur.
data_description.electricity_inflation_percent: Used only in future ROI projections. KEMS still uses actual Octopus rates for current simulations.
data_description.battery_degradation_percent: Reduces projected future annual value over time.
data_description.discount_rate_percent: Used to calculate discounted net value. The proposal benchmark used 6.75%.
data_description.roi_forecast_years: Number of years included in the predicted net-value calculation.

monitoring.title: Monitoring and history
monitoring.description: Choose how often KEMS observes Home Assistant and how much learning history it retains.

data_description.scan_interval_seconds: KEMS reads Home Assistant state only; minimum 30 seconds.
data_description.history_days: KEMS stores compact observations locally in Home Assistant storage.
data_description.gas_kwh_per_m3: Used only when the configured gas source reports cubic metres rather than kWh.

control.title: Control Lab and EPS safety
control.description: Configure simulation, shadow planning and safeguards. Alpha4 still blocks real FoxESS and charger commands.

data_description.operating_mode: Observe, virtual simulation, shadow planning, or control. Real control remains hard-blocked in alpha6.
data_description.virtual_scenario: Inject normal, solar, cloud, high-load, Power Down, outage, overload, or unstable-grid conditions.
data_description.control_enabled: Records explicit control opt-in only. It cannot permit real writes until a verified backend exists.
data_description.system_commissioned: Leave off before the installer has commissioned the KH7 and KEMS has verified all readings and limits.
data_description.emergency_stop: When enabled, KEMS plans zero charge/discharge/export commands and blocks all future writes.
data_description.stale_data_seconds: Fail-safe age after which desired control commands are withdrawn.
data_description.grid_stability_seconds: How long a restored grid must remain stable before normal planning may resume.
data_description.eps_limit_kw: Use the installer-confirmed whole-house EPS continuous limit. The pre-install default is 7kW.
data_description.eps_warning_percent: Whole-house island-load level that raises an early warning.
data_description.eps_critical_percent: Whole-house island-load level that raises a critical warning.
data_description.island_reserve_percent: Warning threshold for reducing discretionary load during a whole-house outage. The normal battery reserve remains the emergency discharge floor.
